description: Header file defining the OemLock class, an interface for OEM lock status management in a confidential environment, including methods for checking and setting OEM lock permissions.

classes.name: OemLock
classes.description: Represents an interface for managing OEM lock status, providing methods to check and modify OEM lock permissions.

methods.name: OemLock
methods.description: Constructor that initializes OemLock with a reference to a Storage object.

methods.name: IsOemUnlockAllowedByCarrier
methods.description: Checks if OEM unlock is allowed by the carrier.

methods.name: IsOemUnlockAllowedByDevice
methods.description: Checks if OEM unlock is allowed by the device.

methods.name: IsOemUnlockAllowed
methods.description: Checks if OEM unlock is generally allowed.

methods.name: IsOemLocked
methods.description: Checks if the device is currently OEM locked.

methods.name: SetOemUnlockAllowedByCarrier
methods.description: Sets whether OEM unlock is allowed by the carrier.

methods.name: SetOemUnlockAllowedByDevice
methods.description: Sets whether OEM unlock is allowed by the device.
